name: COMMUNITY-CONTENT-CONSUMER-AND-FANOUT-STAGE3
status: implemented in knode-community; verified against H2 MySQL-mode concurrency/out-of-order/lease tests and end-to-end TLS Stream integration

consumer.bootstrapOffset: 0-0 with MKSTREAM (never $ so pre-startup published events are never lost)
consumer.pendingRecovery: XPENDING + XCLAIM for entries idle >= KNODE_COMMUNITY_STREAM_CLAIM_IDLE_MS (default 30000ms)
consumer.ackBoundary: XACK executes strictly after the single local READ_COMMITTED SQL transaction (community_event_inbox + community_article_projection + outbox task enqueue) commits. Transient DB failures roll back and leave the entry in PEL without XACK.
supportedEvents: ArticlePublished (v1/v2): updates projection and enqueues PUBLISH_FACT:<publicationFactId> once
ArticleContentChanged (v1/v2): advances projection monotonically; never triggers publish notification
ArticleVisibilityChanged (v1/v2): updates projection to PUBLIC or WITHDRAWN; republish never re-notifies
ArticleDeleted (v1/v2): permanent DELETED tombstone barrier; older events never resurrect visibility
CommentCreated / CommentReplied (v1): enqueues COMMENT:<commentId> / COMMENT_REPLY:<commentId> when actorId != receiverId
ArticleCounterChanged (v1): validated, recorded as IGNORED in inbox, and ACKed
consumer.poisonHandling: Malformed, oversized, or unsupported schema events are durably recorded as DEAD in community_event_inbox and ACKed so poison messages remain visible in ops without blocking healthy events.
consumer.outOfOrderGuarantee: If ArticleContentChanged(rev=2) arrives before ArticlePublished(rev=1), projection retains rev=2/latest title while ArticlePublished still enqueues PUBLISH_FACT:<publicationFactId> so first-publication notifications are never lost.

workers.leaseSafety: Every claim generates a fresh UUID lease_token with DB-clock locked_until. Completion, cursor advancement, and retry/DEAD transitions all require WHERE id=? AND status='PROCESSING' AND lease_token=?, preventing expired late workers from clobbering reclaimed tasks.
workers.fanoutMode: Followers >= KNODE_COMMUNITY_LARGE_AUTHOR_THRESHOLD (default 10000) writes single yan_author_publish_event row (read-fanout); otherwise writes yan_user_notification batches and advances cursor_follower_id atomically in the same SQL transaction.
workers.retryAndDeadLetter: Bounded exponential backoff up to max_retry (default 8), then transitions to visible DEAD state.

configuration.redisIsolation: Standalone TLS Lettuce connection requiring distinct credentials from KNODE_AUTH_REDIS_*; numeric IP host; no XTRIM/MAXLEN/SCAN/KEYS.
